Sri Lanka Society of Physiotherapy
3
(Incorporation)
to  educate  its  members  of  the  physiotherapy
profession  and  keep  them  informed  of  the  latest
developments  and  advancement  in  physiotherapy,
locally  and  internationally;
to establish a forum which enables the members to
exchange their knowledge and skills in the fields of
physiotherapy;
to  improve  the  standard  of  professional  conduct
of  members  in  order  to  promote  and  achieve
efficiency  and  effectiveness  of  the  physiotherapy
professionals
to  establish  a  code  of  professional  conduct  of
persons registered with the Society;
to  publish  a  periodical  journal,  this  shall  be  the
journal of the Society;
to conduct periodical meetings of the members of
the  Society;
to  purchase,  lease,  rent,  hold  and  dispose  of  any
land and premises for use as halls, libraries, lecture
rooms or any other purpose of the Society;
to provide instruction and training to members of
the  Society;
to  conduct  research  into  issues  in  the  field  of
physiotherapy;
to  make  grants  to  universities,  other  educational
institutions  of  individuals  of  high  professional
standard,  for  promotions  of  the  study  of  subjects
relevant  to  physiotherapy;
